recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed for FHIR-25043 unless the profiling glossary table is rewritten in the future.
issue_request: FHIR-25043 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for the profiling page's glossary table. It reported that a Profile was described as a StructureDefinition with kind = constraint even though profile StructureDefinitions have kind = resource, and the resolution was to change kind to derivation.
initial_application: Commit b849e8879808db9a14195bc5aba691f278a3e7ad, 'Fix FHIR-25043', changed source/profiling.html from kind = constraint to derivation = constraint. The Jira snapshot also records PR HL7/fhir#1741.
additional_context: FHIR-37417 later reported the same page wording and was also Published/Persuasive. FHIR-I Confluence minutes for 2020-04-06 list FHIR-25043 as a technical correction, and no later community evidence was found that changes the approved correction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/profiling.html already has derivation = constraint and current-source grep found no remaining stale kind = constraint wording under source/.
